Question

Hi everyone,

I am very excited to get started using mini.completion with mini.snippets, but I can't seem to get it to work correctly, the two modules are working, just not with each other!

add({ source = "echasnovski/mini.nvim", depends = { "rafamadriz/friendly-snippets" } })

require("mini.completion").setup()
require("mini.snippets").setup({
  snippets = { require("mini.snippets").gen_loader.from_lang() }
})

As you can see I have both modules setup, and I have friendly-snippets installed too.

But, if I open a CSS file, and try seeing snippets in mini.completion they don't appear in the list:

But if I type out a snippet that I know exists in the css.json friendly-snippets file e.g. aife, and then expand with <C-J> it works fine. So both modules are working, just not together!

Note that I have no completion suggestions for aife even those this directly matches a snippet prefix:

Can anyone help?

For reference here is the rest of my setup

comment_data.body:
> As you can see I have both modules setup, and I have friendly-snippets installed too.
> 
> But, if I open a CSS file, and try seeing snippets in mini.completion they don't appear in the list:

~~That is currently not supported. But I can see the confusion.~~ **Edit**: This is now supported via `MiniSnippets.start_lsp_server()`. See [this comment](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/discussions/1647#discussioncomment-12868609) for more details.

'mini.snippets' provides two big sets of functionality:
- Insert snippet at cursor for user to interactively adjust it during snippet session.
- Manage/load snippets from custom files and match them according to the current context.

'mini.completion' now supports using 'mini.snippets' *for inserting* snippet items that it gets from the LSP server. You can see that by selecting any entry with "S" symbol and pressing `<C-j>`.

However, there is currently no easy way to "bridge" information about loaded snippets to 'mini.completion'. As the latter is designed to *only* support LSP+fallback, the only way for that is to create a "dummy" in-process LSP server specifically to provide snippets from 'mini.snippets'. That will be my next goal in LSP journey. **Edit**: this "dummy" in-process LSP server is already possible in 'mini.snippets'. See top of this comment.

Thanks for asking! I'll use this as a reference for future work and similar questions.

comment_data.body: @LkeMitchll, there is now (finally) a way to expose snippets collected/prepared/loaded by 'mini.snippets' to (auto)completion engines like 'mini.completion': add a [`MiniSnippets.start_lsp_server()`](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/6be765891c95242f6b8ebd3a25aa285ab3e9f6de/doc/mini-snippets.txt#L1240) call after `require('mini.snippets').setup()`. This will start a dedicated LSP server for 'mini.snippets' which will provide its collected snippets as completion suggestions.

> If I use `mini.nvim` itself I have to explicitly enable plugins via their `.setup()` call, right?

Correct. Everything that is not `setup()` will not provide any side effects, only the code itself is usable via `require('mini.xxx')`.

`MiniSnippets.start_lsp_server()` is not yet part of any release and only part of the `main` branch. Here are places where it is mentioned:
- In the list of features: both in [help file](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/088d67751584e4168f35bca89bad70ada7ea4636/doc/mini-snippets.txt#L32-L34) and [README](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/readmes/mini-snippets.md#features).
- In overview of [how expand works](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/088d67751584e4168f35bca89bad70ada7ea4636/doc/mini-snippets.txt#L311-L315).
- In the [changelog](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#minisnippets).

Actual 'mini.nvim' releases are usually announced via making [GitHub release](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/releases), updating `stable` branch, and making a Reddit post in `r/neovim` subreddit.
